name: ru-ready
description: R U Ready? — AI-Powered Mock Interview Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently --names "gateway,auth,oral,coding,ai,analytics,user,payment,admin,roadmap,resume,challenge,sysdesign,client" -c "blue,cyan,green,yellow,red,magenta,blue,cyan,yellow,green,magenta,yellow,blue,cyan" "corepack pnpm --filter gateway dev" "corepack pnpm --filter auth-service dev" "corepack pnpm --filter oral-interview-service dev" "corepack pnpm --filter coding-interview-service dev" "corepack pnpm --filter ai-analysis-service dev" "corepack pnpm --filter analytics-service dev" "corepack pnpm --filter user-service dev" "corepack pnpm --filter payment-service dev" "corepack pnpm --filter admin-service dev" "corepack pnpm --filter roadmap-service dev" "corepack pnpm --filter resume-service dev" "corepack pnpm --filter challenge-service dev" "corepack pnpm --filter system-design-service dev" "corepack pnpm --filter client dev"
scripts.build: corepack pnpm db:generate && corepack pnpm --filter shared build && corepack pnpm --filter gateway build && corepack pnpm --filter "./services/*" build && node scripts/copy-prisma-generated.mjs && corepack pnpm --filter client build
scripts.clean: corepack pnpm -r exec -- rm -rf node_modules dist .turbo
